I have learned Ventress has returned to Dathomir. Go there and wipe the witches out. All of them.|Count Dooku, to General Grievous|}} The '''Battle of Dathomir''' was an engagement in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], that resulted in the [[Death/Legends|annihilation]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Seeking revenge for a previous [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|assassination attempt]] concocted by his former [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] of the Nightsisters, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sanctioned an invasion of Dathomir to eliminate the entire clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] led the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army's]] assault, bringing a full [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] to strike at Dathomir. After ordering a [[bombing run]] to dislodge the Nightsisters from their [[Nightsister fortress|fortress]], Grievous landed with his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and dispatched them to [[Ground warfare/Legends|besiege]] the [[Witch/Legends|witches]]' village. Undeterred, Ventress led her fellow [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] on an offensive against the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], pushing through the jungles to Grievous's position. After the elder witch [[Daka/Legends|Daka]] [[Chant of Resurrection/Legends|resurrected]] the fallen [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|sisters]] of the [[Army of the Dead/Legends|Army of the Dead]], Ventress took her [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] reinforcements to obliterate a [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]] sent in by Grievous, then headed directly for the droid landing site. Arriving at the Separatist [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|landing craft]], Ventress challenged Grievous to single [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], naming total victory in the battle as the prize. Although nearly defeated in the ensuing [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Grievous had his battle droids attack Ventress and her [[Army/Legends|army]], with the Nightsister retreating from the battlefield after being injured by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. Meanwhile, Talzin used [[Voodoo/Legends|voodoo]] [[Dathomir Magic|magic]] to set a plague upon Dooku, who was monitoring the battle from his [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], to pressure him into calling off his attack. With Dooku unable to defend himself from Talzin's [[Magic/Legends|magic]], Grievous was ordered to target Talzin instead of Ventress, and he personally led his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] to the Nightsister village's [[Hidden Cave/Legends|Hidden Cave]]. Talzin relinquished her magic before [[Teleportation (Force power)/Legends|escaping]], but Grievous's murder of Daka terminated the spell sustaining the Army of the Dead. Without the aid of their zombie sisters, the remaining Nightsisters were outnumbered and massacred. Only Talzin and Ventress evaded slaughter, with the latter leaving the ravaged Dathomir to pursue a newly foretold destiny. ==Prelude== {{Quote|You must give up the ways of the Sith and return to our fold. You will leave Dooku's ''absurd'' war behind and remain with us. No longer to be ordered about. You will be loyal to no one but your sisters, and ''yourself''.|Mother Talzin, encouraging Asajj Ventress to be baptized as a Nightsister|}} During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] proved herself as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], serving at the side of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]—[[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and, less publicly, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus—in the Separatists' war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When Dooku was ordered to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Ventress in a demonstration of loyalty to his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], he abandoned his potential [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] at the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]], leaving her for dead. Returning to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}} Ventress enlisted the aid of her people, the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], to exact revenge on Dooku for his betrayal. The coven's [[Clan mother/Legends|leader]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], used her [[Dathomir Magic|dark magicks]] to transform a [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] warrior, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who—while secretly under the Nightsisters' control—was gifted to Dooku as a replacement assassin.{{TCW|Monster}} Ventress then launched her [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|strike]], using Opress in her bid to her kill her former Master.{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}} [[File:VentressBaptism-Massacre.png|thumb|left|250px|Asajj Ventress is baptized, becoming a full member of the Nightsisters.]] Ventress's scheme for revenge did not go as planned: Opress broke free of her spell and turned on both her and Dooku, while the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] nearly succeeded in executing her as he had originally intended. Forced into self-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]], Ventress escaped and spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] reevaluating her life. She returned home to Dathomir in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, in search of sanctuary. Meeting with Talzin in the [[Nightsister fortress]], Ventress conferred with the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|clan shaman]] on the subject of her future, as she was uncertain of what to do now that she was no longer Dooku's [[Agent/Legends|agent]]. When Talzin proposed that she leave behind the Clone Wars and the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Ventress agreed to be [[Baptism/Legends|baptized]] as a full Nightsister, beginning a new life with her people. Having harbored a grudge against Ventress and Talzin since their attempt on his life, Dooku monitored his former apprentice's movements and learned of her return to Dathomir. Dooku summoned [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] and a rival of Ventress during her service to the Confederacy,{{SWE|characters|asajjventress|Asajj Ventress}} to his [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and ordered him to exterminate the Nightsister [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] before they continued to plot against the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]. Dooku intended for Grievous's confrontation with Ventress to be yet another test of his general's abilities.{{FactFile2014|13|GRI 1-2|Grievous' Cybernetic Body}} Heeding Dooku's orders, Grievous immediately marshaled a massive detachment of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]—including [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], heavy [[Tank/Legends|tank]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], and hundreds of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]—onto several [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], then proceeded to Dathomir with his forces aboard a full [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. ==The battle== ===The invasion of Dathomir=== {{Quote|We will need an army to fight Grievous.''"
"''I will speak with Old Daka. She will get us the reinforcements we need.|Asajj Ventress and Mother Talzin, resolving to awaken the Army of the Dead|}} Grievous commanded his fleet of four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], two [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]], and a pair of [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ships]] from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. Upon exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]], Grievous ordered his crew of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]] to launch the invasion, beginning with landing their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on Dathomir. En route to the surface aboard one of the [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla's]] six deployed C-9979 [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]], Grievous sent an advance [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] to force the Nightsisters from their fortress,{{SWE|technology|hyenabombers|hyena bombers}} where the [[Witch/Legends|witches]] were currently holding a feast to celebrate the baptism of Ventress. Hearing the approach of the incoming [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the skies, the Nightsisters took cover as the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] attacked their home, scattering for cover from the [[bombing run]]s. While his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] squadron was strafing the fortress, Grievous landed to the west in a forest clearing, establishing a perimeter and then deploying his [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] in attack formation. [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and lines of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] disembarked from the landing [[Starship/Legends|craft]], while [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] deployed [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], all of them heading to [[Ground warfare/Legends|assault]] the Nightsisters at their fortress. As the battle droids marched through the jungle, a squadron of ''Hyena''-class bombers and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] continued to besiege the stronghold, targeting the supports of the village entrance. [[File:VentressAdvance-Massacre.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ventress leads her fellow Nightsisters on an offensive to drive back the battle droids.]] One of the supports fell on the Nightsister [[Karis/Legends|Karis]], and though Ventress [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitated]] the beam away with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], she was unable to prevent her comrade from dying. In spite of her distress that she had brought Dooku's attention to Dathomir, Ventress was left with no time for regret, as the battle droids reached the fortress shortly thereafter. Using one of the fallen supports as cover from the droid [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]], the Nightsister [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] took up their trademark [[Nightsister energy bow/Legends|energy bows]] against the invaders, while Talzin used her [[Magic/Legends|magic]] to summon a [[Protection bubble|protective bubble]] and unleash her brand of [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] upon the droids. Recognizing that they were vastly outnumbered, Ventress stated that they would need an [[Army/Legends|army]] to withstand the enemy invasion. Talzin agreed to speak with the elder witch [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]] to assemble the needed reinforcements. Leaving Talzin to raise their reserves, Ventress activated her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|lightsabers]] and took up command of her fellow warriors, spearheading an offensive to drive back the droids. Organizing a multilevel strike, Ventress had some of her comrades take to the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to rain energy [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]] upon the droids from above, while she led the ground push against the eastern front of the invading army, hundreds of droids strong. Behind the Separatist forward lines of B1 and B2 battle droids came [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], intended to strike down any survivors of the advance forces' firepower.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]'' The Nightsister archers were able to shoot down several droid [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] before the latter reached their vantage point in the trees, while other warriors on the ground cut through the B1, B2, and BX-series battle droids with [[Nightsister dagger|daggers]]. The Nightsister [[Luce/Legends|Luce]] stole two droid commandos' [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]] after they destroyed her energy [[Bow/Legends|bow]], gunning down her attackers in quick succession. Ventress held her own against the Separatist [[Trooper/Legends|troops]], making quick work of her droid adversaries with her lightsabers. Supervising his battle group's progress from one of the landing craft at the deployment site, Grievous received reports that Ventress was leading the Nightsisters' assault and elected to send in a [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]], which housed an experimental [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] that would raze organic material to the ground without harming mechanics, such as his droid troops. Once it reached the battle zone with an escort of four Armored Assault Tanks, the Defoliator Deployment Tank launched several [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]], claiming the lives of a number of Nightsisters{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep419|text="Massacre" – ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} and forcing the rest to take cover from the [[Fire/Legends|burning]] carnage, with no cover left for the witches to escape the droids' blaster fire. At that moment, the Nightsisters' reinforcements arrived in the form of the [[Army of the Dead/Legends|Army of the Dead]]. Sustained by Daka's [[Chant of Resurrection/Legends|Chant of Resurrection]], the deceased [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|sisters]] were reanimated as [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]], arriving to aid Ventress to push back the Separatists. The undead sisters mindlessly{{SWE|groups|nightsisterzombies|Nightsister zombies}} ripped through the Separatists' ranks, smashing through everything in their path. Their arrival gave Ventress the opportunity to press her attack against Grievous and his droid army. ===Massacre of the Nightsisters=== {{Quote|Surprised?''"
"''Hardly. You're the one I was sent here for.''"
"''Then fight me alone. Prove you're the greater warrior. If I win, your army leaves. If you win, the Nightsisters will surrender to you.''"
"''I have ''always'' been greater than you.|Asajj Ventress and General Grievous|}} [[File:GrievousVsVentress-Massacre.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ventress battles Grievous to force his army to retreat from Dathomir.]] Bolstered by the numbers of the Army of the Dead, Ventress resolved to use her reinforcements to clear a direct path to Grievous's landing site. She and several other warriors commandeered an Armored Assault Tank whose droid [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] had fallen to the zombie ranks, using the tank's heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to destroy the Defoliator Deployment Tank. With the Undead Army clearing the way through the droids, Ventress and the Nightsisters reached the deployment site aboard their stolen tank, abandoning it to push toward the landing craft. Once Ventress arrived, Grievous disembarked from his ship with several [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], ordering his battle group to hold position while Ventress issued similar orders to the Nightsisters. With their respective armies holding their distance, Ventress met Grievous in the no-man's land and challenged him to single combat, dictating that the victor of their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] would triumph over the loser's faction—victory for Grievous would secure a Nightsister surrender, while Ventress's success would force the Separatist Droid Army to depart from Dathomir. The two longtime rivals [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|began]] to duel, engaging in saberlock after saberlock as Ventress employed her dual [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] against Grievous's four. At one point, Grievous kicked Ventress backward, but the Nightsister responded with a furious attack, relentlessly battering at her adversary's defenses until she landed a blow on the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and [[Cho mai/Legends|severed]] one of his [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. Yet despite being bested, Grievous ordered his battle droids to kill Ventress, forcing her to direct her attention to deflecting enemy fire. As all-out fighting erupted on the battlefield between the Separatists and the Nightsisters, one laser shot slipped through Ventress's blades, hitting her in the shoulder and providing Grievous an opportunity to exploit her momentary distraction. Before he could execute her, a horde of Nightsister zombies intervened, attacking the cyborg general while Ventress stumbled out of his range. Luce attempted to help her to safety but was fatally shot in the back by a battle droid, which Ventress Force-pushed away. After Luce died, Ventress—having seen so many comrades fall that [[Standard day/Legends|day]]—retreated from the battleground and into the jungle, abandoning her coven. Meanwhile, Talzin joined Daka in the village's [[Hidden Cave/Legends|Hidden Cave]], employing [[Voodoo/Legends|voodoo]] magic to inflict a plague on [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku, who was [[holograph]]ically monitoring the battle from his palace on Serenno, in an effort to force him to cease his assault. Although Dooku refused to yield to her demands, he was unable to defend himself from Talzin's magic and thus contacted Grievous via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to relay new orders, as Talzin was intent upon killing the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Receiving Dooku's holotransmission, Grievous was told to eliminate Talzin, his clue to finding her being that the witches' magic manifested itself as [[Color/Legends|green]] mist. Relaying their new target of Talzin to his forces, Grievous led the march to the Nightsister fortress, pressing through the warriors and zombies guarding the village. While the remaining Nightsisters mounted a defense of their home, Grievous proceeded to the Hidden Cave with a squad of battle droids. He had one of his droid commandos blast through the cave's wall with an [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launcher]], exposing Talzin and Daka inside. After Grievous killed Daka, the spell sustaining the Army of the Dead was severed, leaving the Nightsister warriors without their undead comrades. The few Nightsisters still defending the village were massacred by the battle droids, who carried out the onslaught without hesitation. Grievous then turned on Talzin, who summoned her magic to [[Teleportation (Force power)/Legends|teleport]] away from his lightsaber attack and the droids' blaster fire. Nevertheless, Grievous knocked over the cauldron that had been maintaining her voodoo magic, subsequently ending Dooku's [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|What… happened here? Where are the rest of the sisters?''"
"''Dooku sent his minions to destroy us, but we will survive. We ''always'' have.|Savage Opress and Mother Talzin|{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}}} [[File:NightsisterAnnihilation-Massacre.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Battle of Dathomir resulted in the decimation of the Nightsisters clan.]] The Battle of Dathomir{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/172562644451078145|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=Rest assured, the Nightsisters will not go down without a fight. Prepare yourselves for the Battle of Dathomir.}} resulted in a victory for the Confederacy, with all of the Nightsisters killed save for Ventress and Talzin. As part of its mopping-up operations, Grievous's droid infantry destroyed the [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|''Raider'']], a [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]] that Ventress had acquired in the aftermath of the Battle of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].{{FactFile2014|78|VUL 1-2|The ''Vulture's Claw''}} Alone in the forest, Ventress experienced a vision of Talzin and learned of their clan's slaughter, while also being told of a new destiny by the clan mother. Once again forced into exile, Ventress left to pursue her newly foretold destiny, wandering through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and ending up on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, she became involved with a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] led by the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and accompanied them on a [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|job]] on the planet [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]]. Talzin, meanwhile, remained on-world, aiding Savage Opress from afar in his search for his long-lost brother, the Sith Lord [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}} Despite the decimation of her clan, she believed that the Nightsisters would survive, as had been the case throughout their history. When Grievous and the Separatist Droid Army departed from Dathomir, they left behind the remains of their droid forces, with the wreckage of Separatist troops and vehicles scattered amidst the corpses of the Nightsisters. It was in that state that Opress found the derelict Nightsister fortress when he brought Maul to be [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] by Talzin. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Rest assured, the Nightsisters will not go down without a fight. Prepare yourselves for the Battle of Dathomir.|Leland Chee, via Twitter|}} [[File:Concept-NightsisterLairDamaged.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art of the battle's aftermath]] The Battle of Dathomir was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was featured in the episode "[[Massacre]]," which aired on [[February 24]], [[2012]] as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]].{{InsiderCite|131|Launchpad}} Asajj Ventress's duel with General Grievous, one of the central parts of the battle, was previewed prior to then in [[September]] [[2011]] as part of a [http://www.starwars.com/watch/tcw_s4_cntrailer.html promotional trailer] for the season.{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-season-4-trailer|text=The Clone Wars Season 4 Trailer}} The battle was officially named by [[Leland Chee]], the Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], in a [http://twitter.com/HolocronKeeper/status/172562644451078145 tweet] on [http://www.twitter.com Twitter.com]. Besides advancing the series' portrayal of Ventress, the battle opened the season's four-part finale story arc. In [[December]] 2012, [[StarWars.com]] ranked the Battle of Dathomir as the third most memorable moment of the television series from 2012.{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-top-5-moments-of-2012|text=''The
